description: This file defines the StreamConfig interface which specifies streaming configuration settings for the Search service in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving configuration parameters such as array size limits, timing intervals, timeouts, and nested configuration objects. It also defines an enum for known configuration values with default settings.

classes.name: StreamConfig
classes.description: An interface providing streaming configuration settings for the Search service, with methods to retrieve various configuration parameters.

classes.name: StreamConfig.StreamConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue that defines known configuration path expressions and default values for StreamConfig parameters.

methods.name: getMaxArraySize
methods.description: Returns the maximum length of an array for indexing.

methods.name: getWriteInterval
methods.description: Returns the minimal delay between event dumps as a Duration.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout for messages to Things shard.

methods.name: getRetrievalConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for retrieving things and policy-enforcers.

methods.name: getPersistenceConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings for writing into persistence.

methods.name: getCacheConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration settings of the stream cache.
